She wears a teal Egyptian-style two-piece outfit consisting of a cropped top and a long skirt with gold trim. She holds a silver metal flute horizontally to her right side, with her fingers positioned precisely on the keys and her lips near the embouchure hole. (2) She begins playing the instrument while swaying her hips rhythmically. Her facial expression is focused yet cheerful with a subtle smile. Translucent duplicates of her figure appear on both her left and right sides, mirroring her dancing movements with a slight delay. A horizontal musical staff with black notes is displayed at the bottom of the frame. (3) The performance continues as she integrates more complex hand and hip movements while maintaining the flute position. The natural sunlight filters through the overhead tree canopy, creating soft lighting on her skin and the teal fabric. No other people or passers-by are visible in the background environment. The overall visual composition emphasizes a blend of musical performance and stylized dance.
